snippet.title: GRIZZLY'S VR || THE OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Go follow the game on Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/grizzlyvr/756382

SYNOPSIS
Welcome to the Virtual Reality Experience you've been waiting for. Grizzly's, a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame that took the Internet by storm over its ridiculous plot and delivery, has officially come to VR. Enjoy the bombastic experience with a virtual reality headset and watch the story of Grizzly's unfold in an immersive virtual reality. This game will include fan-favorite characters, recreated VHS cutscenes, and additional content that will please fans. Be ready to spend your nights at Grizzly's Burger Joint!

REQUIREMENTS
- Steam VR and Steam Client Installed and Open (PCVR Only)
- A PCVR headset with two controllers (Vive, Oculus, etc.)
- A GameJolt Account (PCVR Only)
- To log in, you need your username and your game token. You can find your game token by clicking on your profile in the top right.
- Room-Scale tracking
- Minimum System Requirements (Quest)

Recommended to use a Quest 2 for the Quest port. The game is playable on a Quest 1 but for a better experience, use a Quest 2.
Storage: 1+ GB available space

Minimum System Requirments (PCVR):
OS: Windows 8
Processor: Intel i5-4590 or greater / AMD FX 8350 or greater
Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD R9 390
Storage: 4+ GB available space

CREDITS -
Lester Tellez - Director, Animation
Yu Ro - Programming/Gameplay
TheTVBunny - Voice Director
Spectre - Cutscenes
VinematicEdits - Editor
Aidan O Flynn - Composer
CokoBeanZ - Animation
FireCat Productions - Animation

VOICE ACTORS -
Nicholas Cortez as Grizzly
KZ as Johnathan
Xander as ???
AllanVO - Movie Guy

#grizzlysvr #ittakesguts #guts #virtualreality #fnaf #fnaffangame #horrorgaming #vr
